program = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    row_separators = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_separators = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(len(grid))}) == 1]

    def blocks(size, separators):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for separator in separators + [size]:
            if separator > start:
                result.append((start, separator))
            start = separator + 1
        return result

    row_blocks = blocks(len(grid), row_separators)
    col_blocks = blocks(len(grid[0]), col_separators)
    separator_cells = {(i, j) for i in row_separators for j in range(len(grid[0]))}
    separator_cells.update((i, j) for j in col_separators for i in range(len(grid)))
    colors = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0]))
                     if (i, j) not in separator_cells and grid[i][j] != 5)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[i][j] == 5 for i in range(r0, r1) for j in range(c0, c1)) > 1 else background
             for c0, c1 in col_blocks]
            for r0, r1 in row_blocks]
'''
program_path.write_text(program)
ns = {}; exec(program_path.read_text(), ns); transform=ns['transform']
print('demo', transform(demo), transform(demo)==demo_out)
answer = transform(test)
print('test', answer)
